description: This file defines the class 'Smarty_Internal_Method_UnloadFilter', which provides a method to unload a specified filter by type and name within the Smarty templating engine. It extends another internal class and interacts with Smarty's registered filters to remove a filter.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_UnloadFilter
classes.description: Class providing the method to unload a filter of a specific type and name from Smarty's registered filters.

methods.name: unloadFilter
methods.description: Unloads the specified filter by type and name from the Smarty registered filters. Checks filter type, then removes the filter from the registry, and cleans up if the filter type list becomes empty.
